summary: Iteration 5 covered the new self-registration feature (doctor + parent), admin approval, data isolation and portal RBAC. Backend: 16 passed / 1 skipped (publish+pdf requires an LLM-generated consultation on TEST_ Bimbo; none seeded yet, so it is skipped by design). Covered: /api/register/start validation (bad email, bad CF, pw<10, pw no-digits all return 422; missing consents 400; existing email 409); doctor full flow (start → verify with wrong code → 400 'tentativi rimasti' → correct code → user created with status=pending → login returns 403 'in attesa di approvazione' → admin lists doctors with the pending entry → attempt to suspend founder (no profile) returns 400 'studio fondatore' → approve new doctor → new doctor logs in, dashboard patients=[] and clinics=[{name:'Studio principale'}] → tenant isolation verified: GET /patients/{bimbo}/passport on new doctor returns 404 while test_doc1 still sees TEST_ Bimbo → suspend new doctor → login 403); verify edge cases (expired signup → 410; 5 wrong codes → 400,400,400,400,429 then record removed); RBAC (parent 403 on /patients, /admin/doctors, /admin/leads; doctor 403 on /portal/me; anonymous 401 on /patients, /portal/me, /admin/doctors); portal (parent /portal/me returns linked TEST_ Bimbo with children>=1; add-child with wrong CF returns linked=false; pdf for fake cid returns 404). Frontend smoke test: landing-register band renders with register-doctor-btn and register-parent-btn, landing-portal-link; /app login shows login-signup-doctor/parent; /registrati/medico and /registrati/paziente render all expected inputs (first_name, last_name, specialty, order_number, email, phone, studio_address, child_fiscal_code, password, confirm, terms-checkbox, submit-btn, parent-form, doctor-form); unauthenticated /portale redirects to /app login (via wrong-area → login). 390px for both registration pages: NO horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: Rate limit is counted only on IP header; behind the ingress every request shares the proxy IP so a single tester consumes the 5/hour slot across the whole user base. Consider per-email throttling or trusted-proxy allow-list.

Wrong-code error pluralization bug: when 1 attempt remains it says '1 tentativo rimasto', when 0 attempts remain it already deletes the record and returns 429 — fine, but the detail string uses 'rimast' + 'o/i' based on `left == 1`; when left == 0 it never shows '0 tentativi' (OK). Just double-check copy for left==1 says 'tentativo rimasto' (currently code reads: 'o' if left == 1 else 'i'; letters 'o' and 'o' OK). Low risk.

action_items: Optional: seed one consultation for TEST_ Bimbo (owner=test_doc1) so iteration tests can exercise /consultations/{cid}/portal publish + /portal/reports/{cid}/pdf end-to-end without burning a live LLM call during test runs.
critical_code_review_comments: registration.py build_registration mounts the admin router on public_api with its own require_role('admin') — good; but the portal router does NOT scope DB calls through TenantDB. It uses raw `db.patients/appointments/consents/consultations` filtered by both patient_id AND owner_id from the child link, which is correct for cross-tenant isolation. Keep this pattern explicit (comment) because a future refactor might drop the owner_id filter.

registration.py:link_children iterates db.patients.find({cf_hash}) with no limit; if a CF collision ever happened the loop would link all; the check `g == email` is case-insensitive via lower() — OK, but guardian_email is sealed/encrypted so unseal_fields is required per-doc (currently done). This is O(matches) per /me request — low volume, acceptable.

registration.py:/register/start checks existing user BEFORE rate-limit; this leaks user-existence to anyone without consuming the rate quota (409 vs 429). Minor privacy concern — consider rate-limit first.

registration.py:/portal/children uses $addToSet on child_cfs even when the CF resolves to nothing; the pending CF stays in the array forever (shows as pending_codes in /me). There is no remove endpoint — add portal-remove-child-{cf} on the frontend + DELETE /portal/children/{cf} to let parents clean up typos.

auth.py:ensure_active runs on every authenticated request via check_session — once a doctor is approved there is a background email send inside set_doctor_status; the send is awaited inline with the admin HTTP response. Consider firing-and-forgetting (asyncio.create_task) to keep /admin/doctors/{uid}/status snappy.
